visualCharacteristics.purpose: small icon cards with title, short text and an arrow CTA link
visualCharacteristics.layout: responsive grid of boxed cards; icon top, text, CTA pinned to the bottom

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: cell 1 icon (image or :icon:); cell 2 title heading, description paragraph, CTA link in its own last paragraph

cells: Optional eyebrow, title heading, description, CTA link (or linked logo images for cards-logo-grid)

usage: Unlock More with Points style feature/action lists.
reuseGuidance: Use for icon-led actions or features. For photo-led cards use cards-image-link.
